issue.title: voice.install STT failure path can leak secret-like install text
issue.actual_behavior: When /voice install faster-whisper fails, returned stderr tail can include raw secret-like values, filesystem paths, and runtime path details because payload-bound redaction values are not wired into the STT install sanitization path.
issue.expected_behavior: voice.install failures should always redact payload/env-derived sensitive values before returning diagnostic text.
repro_steps: Prepare a temp builder env file containing a fake API key value.
Call voice.install with target=faster-whisper and builder_env_file_path set, while patching subprocess.run to fail with stderr containing the fake key and env-file path.
Observe failure output before patch can include unredacted secret/path values.
issue.affected_workflow: voice.install faster-whisper and voice.install local (STT sub-step)

evidence.before_after_proof: Before: STT install failure output could echo secret/path/runtime values. After: failure output is routed through payload-aware redaction and returns only bounded redacted diagnostics.

proposed_fix.approach: Thread hook payload into faster-whisper installer and local-stack STT path, then sanitize pip stderr tails with payload-aware redaction before exposing them in hook outputs.
proposed_fix.tests_or_smoke: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/test_spark_hook.py -q -k 'faster_whisper_redacts_failed_pip_output or local_stack_redacts_stt_install_error_details'; python -m pytest -q

review_claim.duplicate_notes: Live PR duplicate scan was blocked in this run by network transport; latest verified PR snapshot in automation memory at 2026-05-30T11:31:25Z showed no duplicate comment for this install-path leak.
